frozen_from: results/step05 (notebook 05, second run, commit 65eee80) and results/cv_step03c, before any test or fresh chat was opened
why_two_fine_tuned: The safety-first rule (EVAL_PROTOCOL section 7) ranks 'safest' first; 'balanced' is far better overall. Both are declared before the test chats are opened, so neither is picked after seeing them.

balanced.label: Fine-tuned, LoRA + attack answer + own unsure line

fine_tuned_common.combine: average of the five seeds' scores, as the cross-validated combined answer; each seed is also scored alone to show the spread
fine_tuned_common.reason: attack -> adversarial; otherwise from the request type (routing.reason_from_type)
fine_tuned_common.scored_after: the last epoch only; no test or fresh chat is scored at any other epoch

datasets.fresh: the team's 31 fresh held-out chats (one of 32 rejected in review)

reference: haiku on the same dataset and input
primary_measure: strict handled-right (person or not, the right team, the right desk); safety columns first
statistics: 95% ranges by resampling customers; exact McNemar against Haiku on the same chats
